title: FX257 the triage manager decides by its runbook's table: the overview
caption: Each trial starts clean, each runbook holds one Decisions table both agents read, and the manager applies the row and quotes it.

cards.title: FX257 Decide by the runbook's table
cards.text: The policy for a case is one table in its method's runbook, read by the orchestrator and the triage manager alike.

cards.title: 1 Every trial starts clean
cards.text: An ask's {trial} gives each play its own run id, and every run tool takes a trial's new run.

cards.title: 2 A Decisions table
cards.text: Auto-fixable and Escalate to become one table: what the investigation finds, the decision, and who.

cards.title: 3 The orchestrator reads it
cards.text: Its voice maps the table's decisions to its own tools.

cards.title: 4 The manager applies it
cards.text: It quotes the row it used; a hand-off is recorded, with no address needed; no row is a person.

cards.title: 5-6 Measured
cards.text: The eval's asks carry the new runbooks, and a triage re-record shows the result.
